newsitem.title: FRANCE: FRANCE'S CCF EYES CIC - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: FRANCE'S CCF EYES CIC - PAPER.

text.p: French bank CCF does not rule out the possibility of making acquisitions and is eyeing CIC, the regional banking network belonging to insurer GAN, the business daily L'Agefi said on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted CCF chairman Charles de Croisset as saying he did not rule out "proceeding with major transactions aimed at external growth in France and abroad."
"We have the means," he told the newspaper.

The newspaper said the bank was looking at CIC "very closely" and reported speculation that CCF might forge a strategic alliance with a European partner, such as ING Groep of the Netherlands to acquire CIC.
The government last month announced it would privatise state-owned GAN along with its subsidiary CIC.

The newspaper also noted that CCF, whose shares have risen nearly 30 percent in the past 13 trading sessions, could be a takeover target, especially in light of a recent statement by Deutsche Bank that it was looking for a distribution network in France.
"Some traders appear to be positioning themselves for a possible change of ownership for the bank," it quoted one analyst as saying.
The newspaper said CCF's shares had suffered badly in the past 12 months and quoted one analyst as saying they were still undervalued.
